summary: Write for a global audience: avoid idioms, regionalisms, figurative language, metaphors and humor, and keep a neutral tone.
questions: Can I use jokes or idioms in Ansible docs?
How should I write for international readers?

answer_card.title: Write for a global audience
answer_card.answer_md: Keep a neutral tone and avoid idioms, regionalisms, figurative language, metaphors and humor so readers of any background understand.
